messages.content: Propose an ordered list of hypotheses from the registered IDs only. Choose model structures only; do not estimate numeric parameters. Return an object matching this JSON schema exactly: {"items":[{"hypothesis_id":"SENSOR_BIAS","rationale":"…","evidence_refs":["obs:0:1.200"]}]}. Each item requires hypothesis_id, rationale, and evidence_refs; no additional properties are allowed. Allowed IDs: SENSOR_BIAS, VELOCITY_OFFSET, SPEED_STEP, ACTUATOR_DELAY, AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), SENSOR_STUCK, SENSOR_SPIKE_OR_UNRELIABLE, OBJECT_MISSING_OR_DROPPED, BELT_STOP_OR_MOTION_LOSS, POST_VERIFICATION_CHANGE, UNKNOWN_OR_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Lowest RMSE among passing structures; observations show a constant lateral offset plus a speed-dependent drift pattern.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Near-identical RMSE to the two-factor model; actuator delay may contribute marginally without degrading fit.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Very low RMSE; combines bias with both velocity and speed-step effects, though slightly higher than the best two-factor model.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "Low RMSE; accounts for constant bias and a velocity offset, but does not capture speed-step behavior as well as SPEED_STEP models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Passes with low RMSE; explains the consistent lateral offset between nominal and observed positions.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Same RMSE as SENSOR_BIAS alone; actuator delay adds no measurable improvement over bias alone.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Same RMSE as AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET); actuator delay adds no measurable improvement.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
